name: Ultrastable runtime shell
_doc: What it means for a system to run on Ultrastable, as code: one page skeleton, one status vocabulary, one mark. brand/shell/build.mjs bundles this contract with src/shell.css and src/shell.js into artifact/ (ultrastable-shell.css, .js, .json with content hashes); brand/shell/shell.test.mjs proves it; an instance vendors artifact/ unchanged and proves parity against content_hash. Edit src/, never artifact/.
requires: the --ds-* token contract of doctrine/design.json (token_contract plus --ds-font, --ds-mono, --ds-r-s, --ds-r-m, --ds-r-l), supplied by the instance's portfolio layer

layers.core: Never varies between instances: the skeleton below, the status vocabulary (keys, labels, thresholds, wording), the mark, the type scale, 44 px targets, the focus ring, reduced motion, and good/warn/bad as the only status colours.
layers.portfolio: Neutrals, status colours, type pair and shape come from the instance's portfolio through the --ds-* tokens; the shell never names a colour.
layers.instance: An instance supplies only its name, a short plane label, its accent (through --ds-accent) and the live values.

skeleton.holds: instance name, plane label, accent stripe, the instance's own controls, the mark
one status sentence, then one tile per vocabulary key, definitions behind a disclosure

vocabulary.label: Criticality (k)
vocabulary.define: Verified releases in the last 24 hours per unit of cost and human attention. At 1 or more the system sustains itself.

vocabulary.label: Open ignition gaps
vocabulary.define: Links in the chain that still need a person or an outside input to run. Self-sustaining is claimed only at 0.

vocabulary.label: Loops running
vocabulary.define: Loops that reported in on their own clock within their allowed window.

vocabulary.label: Loops stalled
vocabulary.define: Loops that missed their window. Each one is restarted or replaced by the system.

vocabulary.label: Items in, 24 h
vocabulary.define: Work items that entered the queue in the last 24 hours.

vocabulary.label: Items out, 24 h
vocabulary.define: Work items closed with evidence in the last 24 hours. Healthy when at least as many leave as arrive.

vocabulary.label: Cost pace
vocabulary.define: Spending pace over the budget. 1 means exactly on budget.

mark.title: This system runs on Ultrastable: the same page skeleton, status vocabulary and self-running loops as every Ultrastable system.
